review_evidence: README describes a Koch-style 2D snowflake track generator for the 4D Golf game, not a formal proof or specification project.
Complete scan of all four Lean files found only ten program definitions/one inductive data type (Tile, track, n_times, output formatting/main) and zero theorem, lemma, example, or axiom declarations.
The Lean code computes and prints game-track geometry; it does not expose verified semantics, mathematical theorem statements, or proof interfaces under the corpus inclusion invariant.
